analysis:
Documentation-only change to docs/provider/cli-reference.md, supplied as head text with no patch, so changed lines can't be isolated. I read the whole supplied text for statements about security behavior. No code, protocol, auth or crypto change is visible, and I found no claim that contradicts the TB-009, TB-002 or TB-011 text. Relevant statements:
- Lines 484-495 say macOS 27+ enroll returns App Attest guidance only and is not a grant. Legacy profile enrollment is limited to eligible frozen identities, and new identities need qualified App Attest. This matches the frozen legacy MDM cohort limits in TB-009 and TB-011 (T-052, T-054, T-055).
- Line 503 says `unenroll --keep-serving` requires fresh coordinator App Attest removal readiness. This is consistent with T-057, premature MDM removal.
- Line 761 says owner `self_route` authorization does not claim public-fleet eligibility. This matches the TB-002 owner-routing text.
- Lines 128-130 and 649-650 say the Autopilot machine ID is a cohort selector and shadow mode is inactive and observe-only. Nothing there grants serving authorization.
- Line 115 documents `--no-auth` for local mode. This is a pre-existing option, not new.
I saw no new attack surface or invalidated assumption. The next pass should check that the referenced code (Enrollment.swift, ProviderOnboardingPolicy.swift, ServiceDrain, models_replace) matches these docs. I did not review those files.
